production_source_comparison.interpretation: All runtime, build, portable-core and CLI test inputs match their successful runs. The Linux commit only updates the port test wrapper expected group count from 12 to 14. Seventeen research files match the earlier successful REA run. Eight local user extensions are retained.

limits: No real hardware setting or telemetry measurement was verified.
Shimada presence-query mapping is restricted to family 1Ah/model 08h, PCI 1022:153a/BDF 0 and SMU 115.46.0. It maps presence-mask order to firmware target IDs, not OS CPUs/APICs or active cores.

Twelve SVI telemetry fields, three software command mirrors, twelve core rows and three CCD rows have static reference unit evidence: voltage model, temperature, residency/counter percentages, counter fractions and two GHz request policy values. Policy values are not measured clocks or verified setting readback. Two additional core rows and one CCD row have an averaged integer-code representation, with unresolved meanings. Other units, residency state labels, PM physical mapping and live sensor validity remain unresolved; runtime 61h stays denied.

Granite Ridge native capture is restricted to family 1Ah/model 44h, PCI 1022:14d8/BDF 0, SMU 98.84.0 and exact table 620105/1828 or 620205/2452. Unit interpretation is based on the pinned reference; capture firmware provenance and PM physical mapping remain unverified. The two-slot table optionally maps firmware IDs [0,1] through the pinned initializer; one-slot tables remain ambiguous. The available-CPU CPUID/L3 catalog is separate from these firmware IDs and covers only the process affinity set; two sweeps do not establish atomicity or bind PM slots.

An indexed-code consumer slice feeds a shared floor. Separate override routes select firmware channels 1/2, but physical rail identity, electrical range, device-side effects and independent setting readback remain unverified. Software mirrors are not measurements. Other firmware/tuning and previously documented remaining features are incomplete.
EL7 means Oracle Linux 7.9 x86_64. Windows/macOS validate the portable core, not a complete application port.
QEMU verifies module integration only; actual register settings and Secure Boot were not tested.

register_helper_proof.limits: Scripted ready bits prove marshaling and loops only; a stalled bit exhausts the research budget, not a firmware timeout. Completion is not a verified voltage change or independent setting readback.

event_percentages.formula: min(100, counter * 100 / reference counter delta); zero reciprocal branch gives zero

partition_fractions.interpretation: bounded partitions of the C0 candidate fraction; event identities unknown

writers.formula: 0.245 + VID * 0.005; channel 2 uses 0.49 + VID * 0.01 only in mode 1

stored_code_proof.storage_decomposition: storage CCD slot = flat core slot / 8; local core slot = flat core slot % 8

scale.unit_basis: MHz Fmax command convention; binary32 x0.001 on input and x1000 on stored getter

requests.smt_merge: max of first three bytes; min of fourth byte
requests.zero_word: use that thread cached word; both current words zero skip the update
requests.desired_nonzero: both outputs use clipped selected code, unless clipping produces zero

limitations: Static discovery is not a proof that every function has been recovered; only byte-checked slices are used.

Twelve SVI telemetry fields, three software command mirrors, twelve core and three CCD rows have static unit evidence. Two additional core rows and one CCD row have an averaged integer-code representation, with unresolved meanings. SVI values can be stale or zero in scale mode 0; neither channel identity nor applied settings are authenticated. Voltage model is not measured rail voltage; conditional sensors may retain old values; counter fractions/percentages have unverified event identities and freshness; CCD row 11 has a late firmware multiply by 100. Core rows 9/10 are averaged GHz request policy values, not measured clocks or independent setting readback. Other units and physical identities remain unresolved.
Firmware two-slot IDs [0,1] do not establish CPUID CCD/APIC or physical core/OS CPU association. One-slot native mapping remains ambiguous.

61h remains a shared-floor path. Separate override/release commands 11h/12h and 13h/14h select firmware channels 1/2, but do not establish physical rail identity, electrical range, device-side effects or independent setting readback. Software command mirrors are not measurements.
Reciprocal accuracy, floating exception behavior, peripheral effects and live error semantics were not emulated. Packet encodings and polling are checked only against scripted responses.
Synthetic replay does not establish live timing, freshness, atomicity or target-machine acceptance. ASUS 2503 is a reference, not the installed BIOS.
